verses.en: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.pt: Senhor, tu me sondas, e me conheces.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, you have knowledge of me, searching out all my secrets.

verses.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.pt: Tu conheces o meu sentar e o meu levantar; de longe entendes o meu pensamento.
verses.en_web: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge when I am seated and when I get up, you see my thoughts from far away.

verses.en: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.pt: Esquadrinhas o meu andar, e o meu deitar, e conheces todos os meus caminhos.
verses.en_web: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.en_bbe: You keep watch over my steps and my sleep, and have knowledge of all my ways.

verses.en: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.pt: Sem que haja uma palavra na minha língua, eis que, ó Senhor, tudo conheces.
verses.en_web: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
verses.en_bbe: For there is not a word on my tongue which is not clear to you, O Lord.

verses.en: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.pt: Tu me cercaste em volta, e puseste sobre mim a tua mão.
verses.en_web: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
verses.en_bbe: I am shut in by you on every side, and you have put your hand on me.

verses.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.pt: Tal conhecimento é maravilhoso demais para mim; elevado é, não o posso atingir.
verses.en_web: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
verses.en_bbe: Such knowledge is a wonder greater than my powers; it is so high that I may not come near it.

verses.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.pt: Para onde me irei do teu Espírito, ou para onde fugirei da tua presença?
verses.en_web: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
verses.en_bbe: Where may I go from your spirit? how may I go in flight from you?

verses.en: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.pt: Se subir ao céu, tu aí estás; se fizer no Seol a minha cama, eis que tu ali estás também.
verses.en_web: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
verses.en_bbe: If I go up to heaven, you are there: or if I make my bed in the underworld, you are there.

verses.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.pt: Se tomar as asas da alva, se habitar nas extremidades do mar,
verses.en_web: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.en_bbe: If I take the wings of the morning, and go to the farthest parts of the sea;

verses.en: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.pt: ainda ali a tua mão me guiará e a tua destra me susterá.
verses.en_web: Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
verses.en_bbe: Even there will I be guided by your hand, and your right hand will keep me.

verses.en: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.pt: Se eu disser: Ocultem-me as trevas; torne-se em noite a luz que me circunda;
verses.en_web: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night”;
verses.en_bbe: If I say, Only let me be covered by the dark, and the light about me be night;

verses.en: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.pt: nem ainda as trevas são escuras para ti, mas a noite resplandece como o dia; as trevas e a luz são para ti a mesma coisa.
verses.en_web: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
verses.en_bbe: Even the dark is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day: for dark and light are the same to you.

verses.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
verses.pt: Pois tu formaste os meus rins; entreteceste-me no ventre de minha mãe.
verses.en_web: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.en_bbe: My flesh was made by you, and my parts joined together in my mother's body.

verses.en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.pt: Eu te louvarei, porque de um modo tão admirável e maravilhoso fui formado; maravilhosas são as tuas obras, e a minha alma o sabe muito bem.
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise, for I am strangely and delicately formed; your works are great wonders, and of this my soul is fully conscious.

verses.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.pt: Os meus ossos não te foram encobertos, quando no oculto fui formado, e esmeradamente tecido nas profundezas da terra.
verses.en_web: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: My frame was not unseen by you when I was made secretly, and strangely formed in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.pt: Os teus olhos viram a minha substância ainda informe, e no teu livro foram escritos os dias, sim, todos os dias que foram ordenados para mim, quando ainda não havia nem um deles.
verses.en_web: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
verses.en_bbe: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; in your book all my days were recorded, even those which were purposed before they had come into being.

verses.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.pt: E quão preciosos me são, ó Deus, os teus pensamentos! Quão grande é a soma deles!
verses.en_web: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
verses.en_bbe: How dear are your thoughts to me, O God! how great is the number of them!

verses.en: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.pt: Se eu os contasse, seriam mais numerosos do que a areia; quando acordo ainda estou contigo.
verses.en_web: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
verses.en_bbe: If I made up their number, it would be more than the grains of sand; when I am awake, I am still with you.

verses.en: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.pt: Oxalá que matasses o perverso, ó Deus, e que os homens sanguinários se apartassem de mim,
verses.en_web: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
verses.en_bbe: If only you would put the sinners to death, O God; go far from me, you men of blood.

verses.en: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.pt: homens que se rebelam contra ti, e contra ti se levantam para o mal.
verses.en_web: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
verses.en_bbe: For they go against you with evil designs, and your haters make sport of your name.

verses.en: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.pt: Não odeio eu, ó Senhor, aqueles que te odeiam? e não me aflijo por causa dos que se levantam contra ti?
verses.en_web: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
verses.en_bbe: Are not your haters hated by me, O Lord? are not those who are lifted up against you a cause of grief to me?

verses.en: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.pt: Odeio-os com ódio completo; tenho-os por inimigos.
verses.en_web: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
verses.en_bbe: My hate for them is complete; my thoughts of them are as if they were making war on me.

verses.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.pt: Sonda-me, ó Deus, e conhece o meu coração; prova-me, e conhece os meus pensamentos;
verses.en_web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
verses.en_bbe: O God, let the secrets of my heart be uncovered, and let my wandering thoughts be tested:

verses.en: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.pt: vê se há em mim algum caminho perverso, e guia-me pelo caminho eterno.
verses.en_web: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
verses.en_bbe: See if there is any way of sorrow in me, and be my guide in the eternal way.
